{{Quote|I fought the bone-lizards before. Their smell is worse than their bite.|Bowdaar|<ref name="TOR-Kaleesh">{{TORcite|type=codex|Kaleesh}}</ref>}}
'''Kaleesh masks''', also known as '''Kaleesh death masks''' or '''Kaleesh hunting masks''', was a [[Helmet/Legends|battle mask]] worn by most [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Soldier|warriors]] and soldiers from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]], carved from the [[Bone/Legends|skulls]], bones, and [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] of their planet's fearsome predators&mdash;[[Karabbac/Legends|karabbac]], [[Mumuu/Legends|mumuu]], and [[Erkush/Legends|erkush]]&mdash;drenched in karabbac and mumuu-[[Blood/Legends|blood]] before used in battle.

==Description==
{{Quote|You used to wear a mask of real bone."<br>"I reserve that now for only special prey.|Relin Druur and Saes Rrogon|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
Kaleesh masks, also known as Kaleesh death masks<ref name="TNEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> or Kaleesh hunting masks,<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> were hereditary [[Helmet/Legends|battle masks]]<ref name="TNEGAS" /> often<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> made from the [[Bone/Legends|skulls]],<ref name="TNEGAS" /> bones,<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> and [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] of their homeworld's fierce [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] creatures, [[Karabbac/Legends|karabba]], [[Mumuu/Legends|mumuu]],<ref name="TNEGAS" /> and [[Erkush/Legends|erkush]].<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

The Kaleesh masks featured round [[eye/Legends|eye]] openings,<ref name="The Eyes of Revolution">{{StoryCite|story=The Eyes of Revolution|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref> lacked [[Nose/Legends|nose]]<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> and a row of six-pointed<ref name="The Eyes of Revolution" /> teeth in place of a [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]],<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> leaving the wearer's eyes and tusks visible.<ref name="The Eyes of Revolution" /> Some masks lacked teeth, leaving the wearer's eyes, tusks, nose, and mouth visible.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Furthermore, elite [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] families wore ancestral battle masks that were passed down within a house from one generation to the next. Prior to a battle, their masks were painted with karabbac and mumuu [[Blood/Legends|blood]]<ref name="TNEGAS" /> on its brow and cheeks<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> in distinctive patterns for each family.<ref name="TNEGAS" /> Some masks had [[Shaman/Legends|shamanic]] rune on it, calling upon the spirits to provide the wearer strength, speed, and skill.<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> After usage in warfare, they are cleaned and stored until needed again.<ref name="TNEGAS" /> [[Bowdaar]] referred to the Kaleesh as "bone-lizards,"<ref name="TOR-Kaleesh" /> while Overseer [[Harkun]] couldn't understand [[Xivhkalrainik|Xalek]]'s name in his [[Kaleesh (language)|native]] [[Language/Legends|language]] and referred to him as "bone face."<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==History==
After his [[Grievous's father/Legends|father]] [[Death/Legends|died]] in battle, [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] inherited the [[Grievous's masks/Legends|one]] that was carved from a mumuu skull. He created a new one that resembled to his father's when he was transformed into a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]].<ref name="The Story of General Grievous">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref> After [[N-K Necrosis]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was dismantled, the cyborg's armorplast face mask was removed from its head and sold on the [[Invisible Market]], allegedly brought by a high-ranking Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]]&mdash;none other than [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]&mdash;as a Kaleesh work of art.<ref name="Lord of War">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref>

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Saes Rrogon]] possessed five hand-carved ancient Kaleesh [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] masks from the bones of an erkush with a shamanic rune on it and only wore them on special occasions. Rrogan also donned a [[memory mask]] that could change it shape, resembling the erkush-carved mask he wore. Wearing the mask he had worn as his former master's padawan, Rrogon [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|confronted]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]] aboard the ''[[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|Harbinger]]'' over [[Phaegon III]]. In that one act, he felt transformed and bonded to the wonderous, faceless barbarism of his ancestors.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
